name: playback-completion-2026-09-24
rationale: Retain reviewed Vorbis/Opus. Add actual Android-profile AMR NB/WB, Ogg FLAC, WAV PCM/G.711/IMA, AAC and MP3 container audio, regular/fragmented MP4, TS/FLV/AVI and H264/MPEG4/VP8/VP9 video. swresample converts decoder formats to common PCM; swscale converts decoded video planes to presentation pixel format. No network, filters, devices, encoders or unadmitted MPEG2/MP2/MS-ADPCM/AC3. Configuration is a bounded build request, not runtime acceptance. PC-A3c actual Android decoded HEVC Main8 SDR and AV1 Main8 SDR MP4/Matroska; enable software HEVC and pinned dav1d 8-bit for these admitted profiles. Other bit depths/HDR and conditional AC3/EAC3/AC4/DTS/TrueHD remain unproven. extract_extradata is required to retain in-band video configuration across fresh decoder seeks.
